Answer: A
Reason: The chest X-ray (Figure 1) demonstrates a large, dense opacity in the right upper hemithorax with ill-defined inferior margins, which is consistent with a large mass exhibiting heterogeneous features such as necrosis or hemorrhage often seen in Pleuropulmonary Synovial Sarcoma. This appearance aligns better with option A than the description of a sharply marginated, uniform mass in option B.
